steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 40.5-second product film for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "21-ecg-device-film" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. the device comes out of a white haze under moving light rays; the screen sweeps a live ECG; name and line
2. DISPLAY: close on the screen, a point of light, a teal field, the grid, then a trace draws
3. WORKFLOW: the screen steps through monitor, patient list, analysis gauge, rhythm strip and a summary while the power button pulses
4. ENDURANCE: three-quarter view, a battery fills cell by cell
5. MONITORING: a long rhythm strip draws across red paper
6. INTELLIGENCE: a scan line sweeps the strip, labels the beats and fills in the measurements
7. SECURITY: a 12-lead report on screen and a glowing shield draws itself beside the device
8. REPORTING: a printout with three channels feeds out of the side slot in perspective
9. end card: the camera pulls back on the three-quarter view; name, line and maker

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. It uses 4 photos: ask me for my own, or for permission to keep the demo images. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 21-ecg-device-film my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,14,27,39`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: Each scene is a row in SC (start, end, still, camera from/to, screen function, light rays). To use your own device, generate one hero render with a flat green screen, make the other stills as edits of it, run `python3 tools/screen_quad.py still.png assets/img/still.webp` for each and paste the corners into QF/QC/QT; set S0/S1 to the slot's lower lip in slot.jpg. Screen content is plain canvas code (scrIntro, scrDisplay, scrWork, scrBattery, scrMonitor, scrAnalyze, scrReport). The default copy is placeholder marketing for a fictional device; replace every claim with ones your product can back. Credits used for the demo: 4 gpt-image-2.5 calls = 12.
